import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n, i;
    static String s;
    static long[][] comb;
    static int maxN = 66;
    static int[] cnt_a, cnt_b;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] partial, partial_zero;

    static void compute_comb() {
        comb = new long[maxN][maxN];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                // B
                b_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                // A
                a_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r + c + i);
            if (ch == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (ch == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void compute_second_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            int index = a_here;
            int index_zero = a_here;
            if (check(conf))
                partial[index].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
            else
                partial_zero[index_zero].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_coef(int conf) {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))) {
                break;
            }
        }
        for (int j = i; j <= c; j++) {
            if ( ((s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j) == 'A') && (( (conf >> j) & 1 ) == 1)) ||
                 ((s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j) == 'B') && (( (conf >> j) & 1 ) == 0)) ) {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        int set_a = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 0) ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 1) ? i : 0);
        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        int total = set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i];
        int choose = set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i];
        return comb[total][choose];
    }

    static void upd(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] < act[0]) return;
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
            return;
        }
        ans[1] += act[1];
    }

    static long how_many(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int lowerBound = lowerBound(data, val);
        int upperBound = upperBound(data, val);
        return upperBound - lowerBound;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static int upperBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) > key)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] ans = {Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            long act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = get_coef(conf);
            // binary search in partial
            int idx = lowerBound(partial[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idx != partial[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), 0};
                    upd(ans, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), coef * coef2});
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), 0};
                    upd(ans, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), coef * coef2});
                }
            }
            // coeff = 0
            long[] zeroAns = {Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
            int idxZero = lowerBound(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idxZero != partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idxZero);
                long coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    upd(ans, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), 0});
                }
            }
            if (idxZero > 0) {
                long val = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idxZero - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    upd(ans, new long[]{Math.abs(val + act), 0});
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    static long mainFunction() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
        r = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        c = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        s = br.readLine();

        n = 2 * (r + c);

        compute_comb();

        cnt_a = new int[n + 1];
        cnt_b = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        partial = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        partial_zero = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        for (i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partial_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        compute_second_part();

        long sol = compute_first_part();

        return sol;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        System.out.print(mainFunction());
    }
}
